description: Systematically debug a dev-time bug or code-review finding whose cause is unknown, by gathering evidence, tracing the failing path end-to-end, forming ranked hypotheses, and proposing the safest minimal code fix — does not edit code before having evidence. Use when the user says "why is this failing", "why does this throw", "this isn't working", or "help me debug this", with a stack trace from local development or CI. When the symptom is one named test that is red, use fix-failing-test instead. Not for a live production incident, on-call page, or pasted prod stack trace during an active outage — use triage-error instead, which prioritizes fault site and blast radius over a code fix.
